Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator failed to clarify the specifics of the pricing structure that needed verification, particularly regarding whether there are exceptions for children under certain ages (e.g., free admission for children under 3). While the conversation references "facts to look up," the Orchestrator did not mandate the verification of these critical age-based discounts before relying on assumptions during the calculations. This oversight caused an error cascade, as the incorrect assumption led to flawed estimated savings calculations later in the conversation.
